description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV2 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct reading of various media segment types, including video and audio, with optional and encrypted data, and handles error cases such as metadata parsing failure.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: Helper class to verify properties of media segments read by DataReaderV2, including presence of mandatory data, optional data, encryption info, and specific cipher modes.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Builder class to create various types of media segments (video, audio) with optional and encryption parameters for testing.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads data from shared memory for a given media source type, returning a media segment if successful.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory buffer using a frame writer.

methods.name: doSomeMessInMemory
methods.description: Corrupts shared memory to simulate metadata parsing failure.
